title: Number of Pairs After Increment
summary: Maintain nums2 while nums1 stays fixed. Query [1,x,y,val] adds val to every nums2 position in the inclusive range x..y. Query [2,total] counts index pairs, one from each array, whose current values sum to total. Return one count per type-2 query in chronological order, counting duplicates by indices.
officialConstraints: nums1 length 1..5; nums2 length 1..50000; initial values 1..100000. There are 1..50000 queries. Update endpoints are valid, val 1..100000; target total 1..1000000000.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
